messages:
maria-cs: FYI Zeta Health (pilot) requested a short-term regional routing + throughput bump for their APAC demo next Tue. They want traffic to prefer SG region and a temporary QPS increase.

maria-cs: Key asks: 200 qps sustained, 72h window, start 2026-04-05T08:00:00Z. Add IP ranges for peering: 52.23.12.0/24, 18.204.0.0/16. Also want logging retained 30d for audit.

anya-ops: noted. Do they need an allowlist or routing policy override?

maria-cs: Allowlist + regional routing. Ideally we pin to sg-edge cluster and prevent fallback to US unless capacity exhausted. Also flagged potential renewal conversation after pilot — they care about latency and cost.

derek-infra: Can do temporary routing policy + ACL. Quick check: 200 qps -> will it hit burst limits on shared pool? If yes, we should assign a provisional capacity tag.

maria-cs: They are on CS pilot tier, not dedicated. If we can't guarantee, they asked for a grace window and can accept short backoff handling but prefer no 503s during demo.

paul-rls: tagging for capacity planning. @derek-infra can you add a provisional capacity reservation for sg-edge for 72h? We should also set an automatic revoke.

derek-infra: I can reserve a soft capacity bump and an ip allowlist. To be safe I'll add a rate-window and a temporary override in config. Snippet I plan to push:```json
{
  "customer": "zeta-health",
  "window_start": "2026-04-05T08:00:00Z",
  "duration": "72h",
  "region_preference": "ap-southeast-1",
  "qps_override": 200,
  "ip_allowlist": ["52.23.12.0/24","18.204.0.0/16"],
  "auto_revoke": true
}
```

sam-support: quick question: do we need a compliance review for 30d logs retention? Security usually ok for pilot, but if any PHI in payloads we need DSR/PII handling in place. Maria — did customer mention PHI?

maria-cs: Zeta is in health space and they said de-identified demo data. They still want logs for verification. I'll attach the signed DPA in the ticket.

paul-rls: I'll add a renewal note: pilot strong signal -> possible Dedicated conversion in 60d if latency under 200ms. Capture feedback during demo and push into CS playbook.

derek-infra: Pushed provisional config to staging, running smoke test now. If tests pass I'll promote to prod with auto-revoke. Stage logs look OK.

deploy-bot: deploy 2550 -> sg-routing-override applied to prod (provisional). Checkpoints: smoke_ok.

anya-ops: Confirmed routing policy created: `route_policy: sg_prefer_with_fallback=false` + ip ACL added. Auto-revoke scheduled at 2026-04-08T08:01:00Z.

sam-support: Created CS ticket CS-8342 for audit, attached DPA when available, and set reminder for follow-up 7d after pilot to collect qualitative feedback.

maria-cs: Thanks team. I'll run a short enablement call with Zeta on Mon 2026-04-04 to walk through failover behavior and what to expect. Will capture feedback and renewal sentiment during that call. :thumbsup:

paul-rls: Noted renewal risk -> high upside. Add a post-demo eval: latency p95, error rate, and cost per 1k tokens.

maria-cs: I'll drop the demo notes in CS-8342 and ping product if we see any edge regressions.

derek-infra: Change log entry: `provisional qps bump + ip allowlist applied (auto-revoke)` — monitoring dashboards alerted for rate and latency; will keep eyes open.

deploy-bot: monitor alert: no elevated error rates in first 10m after apply.

maria-cs: Perfect — thanks everyone.
